verdict.rationale: vLLM is an inference engine that serves models which take natural-language prompts. However, the evidence shows no capability to operate vLLM itself (serving, configuration, deployment) through natural-language commands; control is through CLI flags, Python APIs and HTTP endpoints. Tool calling and the OpenAI-compatible API are developer building blocks for building agents on top of served models, not natural-language operation of the product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
